summary: Frontend testing completed for Growth Dashboard trading mode persistence and Analytics page. Fixed the trading mode persistence bug - Real Trading mode now correctly persists when navigating away and returning. All reported issues have been addressed.

minor.issue: Returns 404 - Kraken balance not available (expected if Kraken not configured)

issues: Chart width/height warning in console - charts render but show warning about container size

critical_code_review_comments: ✓ Fixed trading mode persistence by adding both lazy initialization and useEffect sync
✓ Added key prop to Tabs component to force re-render on initialization
✓ localStorage correctly stores 'growth_trading_mode' with values 'paper' or 'real'
✓ Analytics page Real Money Portfolio section displays correctly with live data
context_for_next_testing_agent: Trading mode persistence is now working. The fix involved: 1) Adding a getInitialMode function for lazy state initialization, 2) Adding useEffect to sync state with localStorage on mount, 3) Adding key prop to Tabs component to force re-render. All three user-reported issues have been verified as fixed.

Trading Mode Persistence.test_flow: Select Real Trading → Navigate to Analytics → Return to Growth → Real Trading still selected

displays: Top Positions (RIPPLE, ETHEREUM, POLKADOT, CARDANO, AAVE, SUI)

Paper/Real Tab Switching.paper_tab: Shows Paper Trading Mode banner, Paper Trade $500 button
Paper/Real Tab Switching.real_tab: Shows Real Trading Mode - Live Money banner, Trade Real $500 button

fix_details.issue: Trading mode not persisting when navigating away
fix_details.root_cause: useState initial value was always 'paper', and the useEffect that read localStorage ran after initial render, but the Tabs component cached the initial value
fix_details.solution: 1) Added getInitialMode() function for lazy initialization, 2) Added useEffect to sync state on mount, 3) Added key={isInitialized ? 'initialized' : 'loading'} to Tabs component to force re-render after initialization
